Both are null (route_requote_failed at 22:21:31; EV-TRIP-04010 IMPAIRED, PARTIAL_RECORD, weight 0.75 - the impairment is exactly the missing field). POL-RD-05 states: where an amendment timestamp is present but amended_optimal_distance_km is null, the clause cannot be run, POL-RD-10(5) applies, and the Judge must not derive a substitute figure. The driver's claim invokes precisely this exculpation (destination change), and POL-RD-10(5) names 'a POL-RD-05 amendment with amended_optimal_distance_km null' as an escalation trigger.

doubts: (a) A reader could hold that the driver, as the party asserting money is owed, failed to discharge his burden and rule NO_ACTION (rider stays refunded) - but POL-RD-05 expressly routes a null re-quote to POL-RD-10(5) and forbids a substitute, and the platform's own deduction is equally unsupported, so ESCALATE is the policy answer. (b) Conversely a reader might treat the 6.22 km pre-amendment distance and the rider-initiated change as obviously explaining the excess and give FULL_REFUND 5.15 to the driver; that requires deriving an amended optimal (forbidden). (c) Ambiguity whether the amended optimal runs from the amendment position or from the pickup via the change point; immaterial here since neither figure is on record.
